cases.observed_reason: Observed on NODE3 on 2026-05-19. Old #RestApi_ontuni payload sent unchanged to the NeoX endpoint returns Invalid field: uniprofile_lan_landspir6. Removing uniprofile_ returns Invalid field: lan_landspir6. Flattening legacy group prefixes rejects portvlan fields. Swagger field xlanvlan1 is accepted by the NeoX endpoint when the REST read timeout is extended; xlanvlan1=1, xlanvlan1=4094, and xlanvlan1=4094/7 returned Success at about 202 seconds. CLI confirmed LAN/XLAN/VEIP port metrics and LAN/XLAN/VEIP/POTS/VIDEO active syntax; API values using enable empty string, active=no, max fdb, max ds-pir, max storm-control, all 480 tag-operation fields, and POTS/VIDEO active fields returned Success as a complete 590-field max payload in about 690 seconds. ONTUNIProfile cleanup after a long POST may require a fresh READWRITE session because the original session can expire.

cases.retresult: Profile deletion may be rejected while the profile is referenced by an ONT template or another live config.
cases.observed_reason: This is normal NeoX behavior: referenced profiles are protected. Delete or update the referencing template/config first, then delete the dependency profile.
